drills.name: The Triangle Drill
drills.cue: Move the puck in a big triangle around your feet.
steps: Shape: Picture a big triangle around your feet.
Trace it: Move the puck from point to point.
Control: Go slow and clean before you try fast.

drills.name: The Diamond Matrix
drills.cue: Four cones in a diamond, weave the puck around each point.
steps: Set up: 4 cones in a diamond shape.
Weave: Take the puck around each point.
Head up: Glance up between points.

drills.name: Z-Pattern Slalom
drills.cue: Move the puck in a zig-zag, forward-left, then forward-right.
steps: Zig: Push the puck forward-left, then forward-right.
Zig-zag: Keep the Z going down the floor.
Quick feet: Move with the puck.

drills.name: Quick Hands
drills.cue: Control the puck close to the net without needing lots of room.
steps: Start close: A few feet from the net. Keep the puck near your body.
Quick moves: Two or three quick stickhandles.
Outside: Move the puck outside your feet.
Shoot: Shoot right away.
Switch: Reset on the other side and do it again.

drills.name: Catch and Release
drills.cue: Get a pass near the net and release it before the goalie can reset.
steps: Ready: Start near the net with your stick ready.
Get: Get a pass from the side. Catch it soft on your blade.
No extras: Don't add extra stickhandles.
Fire: Shoot right away.
Mix it up: Change where the passes come from each time.

drills.name: Pull Across
drills.cue: Pull the puck across your body before finishing from the new angle.
steps: Come in: Start a few feet from the net with the puck on one side.
Sell it: Fake the shot from that side.
Pull: Pull the puck across your body. Keep your hands away from your feet.
Shoot: Shoot as soon as you create the new angle.
Switch: Switch directions each time.

drills.name: Will's Squares (4-sq Drill)
drills.cue: Quick, light hops through the square. Head up. 20 seconds each.
steps: Set up: Mark a square on the floor. Number the corners 1, 2, 3, 4. Stay low.
Both feet: Hop 1-2, then 1-3, then 1-4. Do each for 20 seconds.
Right foot only: Same patterns. Hop 1-2, 1-3, 1-4. 20 seconds each.
Left foot only: Same thing. Hop 1-2, 1-3, 1-4. 20 seconds each.
Both feet, long patterns: 1-2-3, 1-4-2, 1-2-4-3 and more. 20 seconds each. Push hard, land light, head up.

drills.name: Skater Jumps
steps: Start: One leg, knee bent, like a skater push-off.
Jump: Jump sideways and land soft on the other leg.
Stick it: Bend the knee. Hold your balance for one second.
Back: Jump back the other way. Control matters more than distance.

drills.name: Single-Leg RDL
drills.cue: Balance on one leg. Tip forward like a seesaw.
steps: Balance: Stand on one leg with a soft bend in that knee.
Tip: Bend at the hips. Reach toward the floor as your back leg lifts behind you.
Stay level: Keep your back flat and hips level, like a seesaw tipping.
Stand up: Squeeze the standing leg to stand back up tall. Do all reps, then switch legs.

drills.name: Sit-ups
drills.cue: Curl up with your belly, not your neck.
steps: Down: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Arms: Cross your arms or reach your hands toward your knees.
Curl: Curl up slowly using your belly, not your neck.
Lower: Lower back down with control. Breathe out on the way up.
